note: Gregorian dates of holidays that move around the calendar, read from the linked Wikipedia tables on the read date. Years the tables did not cover are simply absent: an event with no date for a year is never active that year.

hanukkah.note: Listed as sunset on the first date to nightfall on the last; the first date is the evening before the first full day.

lunar_new_year.note: First day of the first Chinese lunisolar month.
